# INLINE-TXT.md

LightSpeedWP **.txt** standards (notably WordPress plugin `readme.txt`).

## WordPress readme.txt header
```
=== Plugin Name ===
Contributors: lightspeedwp
Tags: tours, ecommerce
Requires at least: 6.3
Tested up to: 6.7
Stable tag: 1.2.0
License: GPLv2 or later
```

## Sections
- **Description** (short and long)
- **Installation**
- **FAQs**
- **Screenshots** (if applicable)
- **Changelog** (see our CHANGELOG template)
- **Upgrade Notice**

Keep prose concise; use bullet lists and code examples where helpful.
